candidates.statement: Every new public core command requires contract tests, public CLI dogfood, explicit fallback or failure behavior, and truth-bound documentation before its phase gate closes.

transition_log.reason: Repeated independent observations met the deterministic support threshold.

candidates.statement: Route non-trivial contexxxt core changes through the public resolve, verification, and observation loop.

skill_contract.name: contexxxt-core-development
skill_contract.description: Use for non-trivial changes to contexxxt core commands, Project Model contracts, Query Layer, resolver, providers, learning, skills, or evals. Route the task through contexxxt resolve, scoped retrieval, verification, and structured observation.
positive_triggers: Add a new filter to the contexxxt Query Layer and preserve deterministic budgets.
Change the Project Model schema and update the resolver contract safely.
negative_triggers: Fix a typo in the public landing page heading without changing product behavior.
Explain what contexxxt is without modifying files or running a development workflow.

boundary_triggers.prompt: Update README wording because a core command changed its actual behavior.
Translate one README sentence with no product claim change.

workflow: Run contexxxt resolve for the target and human intent, then inspect only unresolved decision-relevant gaps.
Implement the smallest coherent change while respecting the packet constraints and source authority.
Run deterministic verification from the packet and capture an ExecutionObservation without transcript or secrets.
verification: Run the relevant focused tests and pnpm check before closing a core phase gate.
Confirm generated artifacts are no-clobber and the Project Model did not change silently.

transition_log.reason: Repeated independent observations met the deterministic support threshold.
